method: Independent static data review of the exact 22 assigned current-source files, continuing directly from the separately reported deployment review. Used the full 1880-file source snapshot computed immediately before this data review (2026-10-27T03:26:51Z) and recomputed the same full snapshot after completion (2026-10-27T03:34:46Z). Read CAPABILITY-COVERAGE.md in full. Strictly parsed all 20 feature-evidence JSON files with duplicate-key detection and recursively traversed every object, list and scalar. Manually read semantic projections of all remaining evidence fields, all 178 method classifications and assessments, all 50 evidence groups, all 15 additional workflows, and all methodology, count, limitation and acceptance sections; repetitive hash values were structurally checked rather than narrated. Checked current source paths and line bounds, explicit file and array references, and path-keyed hash maps; historical evidence/report references were checked for existence only, without opening prior audit conclusions. Verified exact TypeScript method inventory, JSON schema pointer resolution, legacy-only method set, evidence-group membership and count aggregation against the current generated protocol. Fully parsed every nonblank pnpm lock line using a deliberately restricted YAML reader that rejects unhandled constructs and duplicate mapping keys. Verified the importer against package.json, overrides against pnpm-workspace.yaml, all package integrity encodings, package/snapshot and dependency graph closure, required and installed optional peer references, compatible peer ranges, pinned Node engine ranges, and native OS/CPU/libc metadata. The ignored inspection helpers perform read-only structural analysis and are not product tests. No source was edited and no test, build, install, deployment, network probe, paid inference or personal CODEX_HOME access was performed.
limitations: This is current-file static auditing of lock and evidence data. Historical test, native CLI, Linux, browser and protocol probe claims were not rerun or promoted to validation of this snapshot.

Historical source hash references have 224 unequal occurrences across 126 unique current paths. The files expressly record point-in-time targeted evidence and pending final acceptance; these differences are not evidence of current test execution or a newly confirmed product defect.

Registry tarball contents, cryptographic correspondence between tarballs and stored SRI, dependency vulnerability databases, external service eligibility and live integration were not accessed. Integrity checks here establish valid SHA-512 encoding and internally consistent lock references.

The other 38 tooling_docs files belong to the parent reviewer. Deployment 98 files are reported independently in public-https-round5-deployment.json; this report claims only these exact 22 data files.
